title: Enforcement Decree of the Seoul National University Hospital Establishment Act
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Seoul National University Hospital Establishment Act and matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended on May 7, 2019>

Article 2 (Registration of Establishment)
(1) The registration of establishment of Seoul National University Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "University Hospital") shall be completed within three weeks from the date approval of its articles of incorporation is obtained.
(2) Matters to be registered upon establishment under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office;
4. Names and addresses of officers;
5. Matters concerning the authority of representation;
6. Method of public announcement.

Article 3 (Registration of Changes)
Where any matter under the subparagraphs of Article 2 (2) changes, the University Hospital shall register the change within three weeks.

Article 4 (Accompanying Documents)
An application for registration under Article 2 (1) or Article 3 shall be accompanied by the following documents:
1. For registration of establishment under Article 2 (1), the articles of incorporation of the University Hospital;
2. For registration of changes under Article 3, documents proving the changes.

Article 5 (Effect of Registration Other Than Registration of Establishment)
Matters subject to registration other than registration of establishment may not be asserted against third parties until they have been registered.

Article 6 Deleted. <December 11, 2002>

Article 7 (Duties of the Auditor)
(1) The duties of the auditor shall be as follows:
1. Auditing the status of the University Hospital's property;
2. Auditing accounting and related affairs;
3. Auditing other matters prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
(2) Where any impropriety or deficiency is discovered as a result of an audit, the auditor shall report that fact to the board of directors and the Minister of Education without delay. <Amended on February 1, 1991; December 11, 2002; February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(3) Matters concerning the methods, procedures, etc. for the auditor's performance of duties shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 8 (Board of Directors)
(1) Deleted. <December 11, 2002>
(2) The chairperson shall convene meetings of the board of directors and preside over them.
(3) Except as otherwise specifically provided in statutes and regulations or the articles of incorporation, the board of directors shall adopt resolutions with the attendance of a majority of the incumbent directors and the affirmative votes of a majority of the directors present. <Amended on December 11, 2002>
(4) Outside persons with extensive knowledge and experience in hospital management under Article 8 (2) of the Seoul National University Hospital Establishment Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be persons who have at least three years of experience managing a general hospital under Article 3 (2) 3 (e) of the Medical Service Act or at least 10 years of experience performing medical services or administrative work at a general hospital. <Newly Inserted on December 11, 2002; May 7, 2019>
(5) The auditor may attend meetings of the board of directors and state opinions.

Article 9 (Acting on Behalf of the Chairperson)
The directors who shall act on behalf of the chairperson when the chairperson is unable to perform duties due to unavoidable circumstances, and their order of precedence, shall be as follows: <Amended on December 30, 2025>
1. The Vice Minister of Education;
2. The Vice Minister of Health and Welfare;
3. The Vice Minister of Planning and Budget;
4. The president of the University Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "president");
5. The dean of the College of Medicine of Seoul National University;
6. The president of Seoul National University Dental Hospital.

Article 10 (Recommendation of the President)
(1) Pursuant to Article 10 (3) of the Act, the board of directors shall recommend as president a person falling under any of the following subparagraphs: <Amended on May 7, 2019; August 9, 2022>
1. A faculty member of a college of medicine (including a professional graduate school of medicine) with at least 10 years of teaching experience;
2. A medical professional under Article 2 (1) of the Medical Service Act with at least 10 years of medical experience.
(2) A person recommended as president pursuant to paragraph (1) shall submit the following documents to the board of directors, and the chairperson shall submit them to the Minister of Education: <Amended on August 9, 2022>
1. A hospital management plan and annual plans for implementing hospital management;
2. A plan for strengthening the hospital's public character and annual implementation plans for strengthening its public character (each plan shall include a plan concerning public health and medical service projects under subparagraph 6 of Article 6 of the Act).

Article 11 (Acting on Behalf of the President)
The persons who shall act on behalf of the president pursuant to Article 10 (5) of the Act, and their order of precedence, shall be as follows: <Amended on August 9, 2022>
1. The vice president for medical services;
2. The vice president for pediatric services;
3. The vice president for public services;
4. The director of administration.

Article 12 (Subordinate Organizations)
(1) The University Hospital shall have a Medical Services Division, Pediatric Services Division, Public Services Division, Administration Department, Planning and Coordination Office, Education and Research Department, and Public Relations Office under the president, which may be operated on an integrated basis as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Amended on February 22, 1985; May 26, 1994; April 4, 1997; April 19, 1999; December 11, 2002; March 9, 2004; August 9, 2022>
(2) The Medical Services Division, Pediatric Services Division, and Public Services Division shall each have one vice president; the Administration Department shall have one director of administration; the Planning and Coordination Office and Public Relations Office shall each have one head; and the Education and Research Department shall have one head, and these positions may be held concurrently according to the circumstances of the University Hospital. <Amended on August 9, 2022>
(3) The vice presidents and the director of administration shall be appointed by the president with the consent of the board of directors. In such cases, the vice president of each division shall be appointed from among faculty members concurrently performing duties at the University Hospital pursuant to Article 12 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "faculty members holding concurrent positions"). <Amended on April 4, 1997; May 7, 2019; August 9, 2022>
(4) The Public Services Division under paragraph (1) shall be responsible for overall management and coordination concerning the assurance of the public character of Seoul National University Hospital's activities under Article 6 of the Act. <Newly Inserted on August 9, 2022>
(5) Matters concerning the allocation of duties among the divisions, the Administration Department, the offices, and the Education and Research Department under paragraph (1), and the composition, allocation of duties, etc. of other subordinate organizations, shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Newly Inserted on August 9, 2022>

Article 13 (Duties and Remuneration of Faculty Members Holding Concurrent Positions)
(1) For faculty members holding concurrent positions who are assigned to positions prescribed in Article 12 (2), teaching hours may be waived or reduced, notwithstanding Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Higher Education Act. <Amended on April 19, 1999>
(2) Remuneration for faculty members holding concurrent positions shall be paid by their original institutions as prescribed by the articles of incorporation of Seoul National University, a national university corporation. <Amended on February 22, 1985; January 4, 2001; September 6, 2011>
(3) The University Hospital may pay allowances to faculty members holding concurrent positions as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.
(4) Faculty members holding concurrent positions shall comply with the articles of incorporation and various regulations of the University Hospital and faithfully perform their hospital duties. <Amended on July 2, 2019>

Article 14 (Termination of Concurrent Positions)
Where a faculty member holding a concurrent position violates Article 13 (4) or falls under any subparagraph of Article 78 (1) of the State Public Officials Act, the president may, following deliberation by the personnel committee prescribed in the articles of incorporation, request the President of Seoul National University, a national university corporation, to take appropriate measures, such as termination of the concurrent position. <Amended on February 22, 1985; September 6, 2011>

Article 15 Deleted. <December 11, 2002>

Article 16 (Requests for Contributions)
Where the University Hospital intends to receive a contribution pursuant to Article 14 (1) of the Act, it shall submit a request for a contribution to the Minister of Education by April 30 of each year, accompanied by the following documents:
1. A business plan;
2. A projected statement of financial position and a projected income statement;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the request for a contribution.

Article 17 (Applications for Disbursement of Contributions)
Where the details of a request for a contribution under Article 16 have been reflected in the Government budget and the University Hospital intends to receive disbursement of the contribution, it shall submit an application for disbursement to the Minister of Education, accompanied by quarterly business plans and quarterly budget execution plans. <Amended on February 1, 1991; December 11, 2002; February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>

Article 18 (Requests for Subsidies and Applications for Their Disbursement)
(1) Where the University Hospital intends to receive subsidies pursuant to Article 14 (2) of the Act and the proviso of paragraph (3) of that Article, it shall, by April 30 of each year, submit to the Minister of Education a request for subsidies for the following year, classified into subsidies for medical education and research, subsidies for operation of facilities and equipment, and subsidies for repayment of principal and interest on foreign loans, accompanied by the following documents. <Amended on May 7, 2019>
1. A medical education plan and a clinical research plan (only where intending to receive subsidies for medical education and research);
2. An operation plan for facilities and equipment (only where intending to receive subsidies for operation of facilities and equipment);
3. A plan for repayment of principal and interest on foreign loans (only where intending to receive subsidies for repayment of principal and interest on foreign loans);
4. A projected income statement;
5. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the request for subsidies.
(2) Article 17 shall apply mutatis mutandis to applications for disbursement of subsidies.

Article 19 Deleted. <December 11, 2002>

Article 20 (Disposition of Surpluses)
Where the University Hospital has a surplus at the end of each business year, it shall cover carried-forward profits and losses and carry forward the remaining balance to the following year. <Amended on December 11, 2002>

Article 21 (Reporting of Business Plans)
Pursuant to Article 17 of the Act, the president shall prepare a business plan and a budget showing the expected amounts of income and expenditure for each project and report them to the Minister of Education no later than 20 days before the beginning of the business year.

Article 22 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Revenues and Expenditures)
When submitting a statement of settlement of revenues and expenditures to the Minister of Education pursuant to Article 18 of the Act, the president shall attach the following documents:
1. The statement of financial position and statement of settlement of receipts and disbursements for the relevant year;
2. A table comparing the business plan for the relevant year with its implementation performance;
3. The auditor's audit report.

Article 23 (Criteria for Imposing Administrative Fines)
The criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 21 (1) of the Act shall be as set out in the Annex.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 9050, June 21, 1978>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Expenses of Establishment)
(1) The incorporation commissioners under Article 2 of the Addenda to the Act may borrow and use funds necessary for the establishment of the University Hospital with the approval of the Minister of Education and Culture.
(2) The expenses under paragraph (1) shall be borne by the University Hospital.

Article 3 (Gratuitous Use of State Property)
State property succeeded to gratuitously by the general account pursuant to Article 3 of the Addenda to the Act shall be deemed to have been permitted to be used gratuitously under the respective jurisdiction of the hospitals affiliated with the College of Medicine and the College of Dentistry of Seoul National University belonging to the Special Account for Hospitals Affiliated with National Universities, until the State property necessary for the operation of the University Hospital is transferred gratuitously.

Article 4 (Disbursement of Transfers)
The undisbursed amount of the budget for transfers from the general account to be disbursed to the hospitals affiliated with the College of Medicine and the College of Dentistry of Seoul National University within the Special Account for Hospitals Affiliated with National Universities for fiscal year 1978 shall be disbursed to the University Hospital as a contribution.

Article 5 (Disbursement of Surplus from Settlement of Accounts)
The surplus from settlement of accounts of the hospitals affiliated with the College of Medicine and the College of Dentistry of Seoul National University within the Special Account for Hospitals Affiliated with National Universities before the establishment of the University Hospital, and the balance remaining after deducting the expenditures from the revenues of the hospitals affiliated with the College of Medicine and the College of Dentistry of Seoul National University for 1978, shall be disbursed to the University Hospital pursuant to Article 5 of the Addenda to the Act.
